name: 92651 · Laguna Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 92651 (Laguna Beach) has 249 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92651 (Laguna Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92651 (Laguna Beach) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
